'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Serhiy Haidai]], Governor of [[Luhansk Oblast]], says that Russian [[shell (projectile)|shelling]] continues across the oblast and that the 8,000 residents of [[Sievierodonetsk]] are on the verge of a "humanitarian catastrophe". [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/ukrainian-official-warns-catastrophe-captured-city-86437900 (ABC News)]
*[[Assassination of Shinzo Abe]]
**Former [[Prime Minister of Japan]] [[Shinzo Abe]] is shot in the back while giving a speech in [[Nara, Nara|Nara]], [[Kansai region]], [[Japan]], and later dies from his wounds. Tetsuya Yamagami, a 41-year-old [[Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force|navy]] veteran, is arrested for the [[assassination]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-62089486 (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Proposed acquisition of Twitter by Elon Musk]]
**The legal team representing [[entrepreneur]] [[Elon Musk]] files a claim to the [[U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission]] to officially terminate his deal to purchase [[Twitter]], saying that the company made "false and misleading" statements during negotiations. [https://www.theverge.com/2022/7/8/23200961/elon-musk-files-back-out-twitter-deal-breach-of-contract (''The Verge'')]
*[[2022 Rogers Communications outage]]
**[[Rogers Communications]] reports massive outages across [[Canada]], impacting its wireless, cable and internet services, and causing disruptions to banking, government, and emergency services. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/business/rogers-outage-cell-mobile-wifi-1.6514373/ (CBC News)]
*The [[Central Bank of Peru]] increases its [[interest rate]] from 5.5% to 6.0% in an effort to reduce the rate of [[inflation]], which yesterday reached a 25-year record high. [https://www.infobae.com/america/agencias/2022/07/07/actualiza-1-banco-central-peruano-eleva-tasa-a-60-su-decimo-segundo-avance-consecutivo-para-frenar-inflacion/ (Infobae)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[July 2022 European heat wave]]
**[[2022 United Kingdom heat wave]]
***[[British authorities]] issue a level 2 warning as a [[heat wave]] continues. [https://www.msn.com/en-gb/news/uknews/uk-weather-health-warning-issued-as-britain-set-for-second-heatwave-in-weeks/ar-AAZkYRo (''The Independent'' via MSN)]
**[[Portugal]] issues warnings of temperatures as high as {{convert|43|°C|°F}} amid a drought and [[wildfire]]s in parts of the country. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/heat-drought-and-wildfires-torrid-spell-torments-portugal/2022/07/07/934447b4-fe08-11ec-b39d-71309168014b_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[2022 India–Bangladesh floods]]
**At least 16 people are killed and 40 others missing during [[flash flood]]s during an annual [[Hindu pilgrimage sites|Hindu pilgrimage]] to the [[Amarnath Temple|Amarnath cave]] [[shrine]] in [[India]]-administered [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/8/at-least-10-killed-in-floods-during-pilgrimage-in-kashmir (Al Jazeera)]
*Seventeen people are dead after a boat carried into a barge by the tide and capsize in [[Lagos]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/11/bodies-of-17-dead-recovered-after-nigeria-boat-accident (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in British Columbia]]
*****It is announced that [[British Columbia]] will offer a fourth [[COVID-19 vaccine]] booster shot for the general population beginning in autumn. [https://www.theglobeandmail.com/canada/british-columbia/article-bc-to-roll-out-fourth-covid-19-boosters-to-general-public-this-fall/ (''The Globe and Mail'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
*****The [[Food and Drug Administration|U.S. FDA]] grants approval for the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]] for people aged between 12 and 17. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/us-fda-grants-full-approval-pfizer-covid-vaccine-ages-12-15-2022-07-08/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in the United States]]
***The [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention|U.S. CDC]] announces that doses of the [[Smallpox vaccine#Jynneos|Jynneos vaccine]] will be sent to [[Washington (state)|Washington]]. [https://www.kxly.com/cdc-announces-monkeypox-vaccine-allotment-for-washington-state/ (KXLY-TV)]

'''International relations'''
*[[President of Costa Rica|Costa Rican President]] [[Rodrigo Chaves Robles]] says that his country will apply to join the [[Pacific Alliance]]. [https://www.todayonline.com/world/costa-ricas-chaves-launches-pacific-alliance-trade-push-1940191 (''Today'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[LGBT rights in Slovenia]]
**[[Constitutional Court of Slovenia|Constitutional Court]] of [[Slovenia]] rules in a 6–3 decision that bans on [[same-sex couple]]s marrying and [[LGBT adoption|adopting]] children are unconstitutional and gives the [[Parliament of Slovenia|Parliament]] six months to amend necessary laws. [https://apnews.com/article/gay-rights-adoption-couples-44304e6979948be0ac8280e008ddf7b0 (AP)]
*A court in [[Switzerland]] [[acquit]]s [[Sepp Blatter]] and [[Michel Platini]] of [[2015 FIFA corruption case|illegally arranging payments]] while they served as presidents of [[FIFA]] and [[UEFA]] respectively. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/62081675 (BBC Sport)]
*[[Killnet]], a [[Russia]]n [[hacker]] group, launches the largest [[cyberattack]] in the history of [[Latvia]], targeting the country's [[Public Broadcasting of Latvia|public broadcaster]]. The broadcaster says that the attack was repelled. [https://archive.ph/v4i7g (''The Times'')]
